title: The Shapes Dance | Circle, Square & Triangle Song for Kids | Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - English
description:
Come dance with the circle, square and triangle! This fun song helps little ones learn shapes through clapping, moving and spotting shapes all around the house.
Kids learn to recognize round, square and triangle shapes in everyday objects like plates, windows and roofs.
Sing along and make shapes with your hands together!

Shapes, shapes, come and play
round and square and triangle, hooray
tap, tap, tap, tap, the circle bounces
let's all dance today!
Round round circle
square square square
triangle one two three
dance with me, everyone!
Little sister claps her hands
big brother makes a box with his arms
clap, clap, clap, clap, the kids make shapes
look, a shape for you!
Round round circle
square square square
triangle one two three
dance with me, everyone!
Where's a circle? Look, a plate!
Where's a square? A window, wait!
roof, roof, triangle roof, Amma points up
shapes are all around us!
Round round circle
square square square
triangle one two three
dance with me, everyone!
Shapes take a bow, bow, bow
Amma waves, "Goodbye now!"
bye, bye, bye, the shapes wave
see you, shapes, see you!
